summary: Capstone integrates C3.1+C3.2 with explicit cross-references to Lessons 1-4. Loop-omission trap is grade-1-specific with concrete recovery moves. Puppets are explicitly OPTIONAL with no-prep alternatives. Coda+Looper anchor every segment; success_criteria all 'I can'. Children invent and compare strategies. Worksheet practises each named criterion via transfer task — child invents project rather than executing teacher code.
